min_standing_note.value: Must be an enrolled university degree candidate and have completed at least one year of study at the home institution.

excluded_majors.notes: Graduate-level courses are not available to undergraduate exchange students; Business & Economics are open with high-demand registration difficulty.

english_course_availability.notes: US institution; all undergraduate Arts & Sciences courses taught in English.

english_proficiency_and_rhet1020.value: TOEFL iBT >=90, IELTS 6.5-7.0 (no band below 6.5), or Cambridge C1/C2. Applicants studying for a degree taught fully in English (e.g., AUC) are typically exempted upon emailing Brandeis Study Abroad to request an exemption.

host_language_requirement.value: English proficiency required; no secondary language requirement.

fall_term_dates.value: AY 2026-2027: Classes Aug 26 - Dec 3, 2026; Study Days Dec 4 & Dec 7; Final Exams Dec 8 - Dec 16, 2026 (late August arrival/mandatory orientation).

spring_term_dates.value: AY 2026-2027: Classes Jan 19 - May 6, 2027; Study Day May 7; Final Exams May 10 - May 18, 2027 (early January arrival/mandatory orientation).

tuition_model.notes: Reciprocal bilateral exchange students continue paying home-institution tuition and receive a Brandeis tuition waiver; mandatory fees/insurance/room & board still apply.

est_monthly_living_local.notes: Derived monthly cost from AY 2026-2027 Fact Sheet p.6 estimated per-semester living expenses divided by 5 months: Room & Board $10,422 (Ziv suite + required All Access + 5 Meal Plan) + Books & supplies $500 + Personal expenses $600 = $11,522/semester -> $2,304.40/mo (~$2,304/mo). Excludes Health insurance ($3,917/sem), Visa fees ($400), and Airfare ($1,850).

living_cost_usd_est.notes: 5-month estimate derived from monthly USD range 2,304/month. No FX conversion (1 USD = 1.0 USD; 5-month equivalent = 5 * 2,304.0 USD = 11,520.00 USD), calculated 2026-11-15.

mandatory_host_fees_and_insurance.value: AY 2026-2027 estimated per semester: Mandatory Health Insurance $3,917 and Visa fees $400; mandatory on-campus housing & meal plan included in $10,422 Room & Board estimate.

housing_availability.notes: All incoming exchange students are required to live in on-campus residence hall suites with a meal plan.

housing_notes.value: Typically 2-6 person suites with single bedrooms (~80-100 sq ft), shared bathrooms, and common space (Ziv suite + All Access + 5 Meal Plan modeled at $10,422/sem for 2026-27).

host_grants_or_stipends.notes: No incoming exchange grant verified; financial aid/scholarships on brandeis.edu apply to degree students.

visa_lead_time_and_financial_proof.value: J-1 Exchange Visitor visa sponsorship (Form DS-2019) coordinated by Brandeis ISSO via electronic VIDOF (Visa Information/Declaration of Finances) portal requiring proof of liquid financial support for full exchange duration; 2026-27 Fact Sheet p.6 estimates ~$400 visa fees.

course_catalog_url.notes: Admitted exchange students view open sections and register via Workday.

english_course_list_url.notes: All courses in Brandeis Registrar Schedule (https://www.brandeis.edu/registrar/registration/schedule.html) are taught in English; no separate English-only filter URL.

credit_system_and_load.value: US semester credits (most courses 4 credits). Exchange students must take 12 credits min, up to 20 credits max with permission; typical load 16 credits (4 courses).

course_restrictions_note.value: Graduate-level courses are closed to undergraduate exchange students; Business and Economics courses are high-demand and difficult to register for; some courses require instructor/prerequisite review; add/drop spans first 2 weeks.

value: Online Application (Personal & Academic Info, Emergency Contact, Personal Statement, Profile Photo, Passport photo page)
required_application_docs.notes: Transcript and English scores submitted via home exchange coordinator.

academic_style.value: US liberal arts seminar/lecture participation model: class attendance often counts toward final grades, continuous multi-assignment assessment throughout semester, active class discussion.

city_tier.notes: Located in Waltham, MA (~10 miles outside downtown Boston); official city population tier threshold not verified on brandeis.edu.

campus_type.notes: brandeis.edu describes Waltham campus as ~10 miles outside downtown Boston without explicit suburban/urban classification label in verified excerpts.

daily_life_english_friendliness.notes: Not explicitly rated on brandeis.edu or Fact Sheet (US English-speaking campus).

international_support_services.value: Office of Study Abroad, ISSO visa advising, mandatory Orientation, Brandeis Counseling Center, BUGS peer tutoring, Brandeis Writing Center, Spiritual Life chapels/Muslim prayer room, 250+ clubs, Gosman Sports Center.

nomination_deadlines.value: Fall/Academic Year: Partner Nomination Apr 1 (apps open Feb 1), Student Application May 1. Spring: Partner Nomination Sep 15 (apps open Aug 1), Student Application Oct 15.
